profile.geoLocationName: Hyde Park, New York, United States
profile.summary: I've been programming and studying programming since I was 10 years old. I would spend my afternoons sitting in a Barnes and Nobles, reading programming textbooks and hand-writing code because at the time I didn't have a laptop. I created and deployed my first website in the 7th grade using PHP and MySQL to host a basic blog. Now I'm a full time software engineer living my childhood dream. I am a full stack engineer with 5+ years of experience in TypeScript, JavaScript, CSS, React, Svelte, Docker and many other tools and languages.

honors.title: Distinguished Capstone Presentation
honors.description:
https://newpaltz.meritpages.com/stories/Trevor-Brown-presents-capstone-at-SUNY-New-Paltz-Computer-Science-senior-project-event-/81179354
SUNY New Paltz student Trevor Brown presented computer science senior projects on May 4.

Students took part in externship internships in local companies or clients on campus. Projects include website development, workflow and document management, business intelligence and automation, AI for image recognition, and information visualization.
honors.issuer: Issued by SUNY New Paltz · May 2022

honors.title: SUNY New Paltz Deans List 2019
honors.description:
https://newpaltz.meritpages.com/stories/SUNY-New-Paltz-student-Trevor-Brown-earns-fall-19-Dean-s-List-honors-/24164948
SUNY New Paltz is proud to congratulate Trevor Brown of Hyde Park, New York, for being named to the Dean's List for the fall 2019 semester.

Dean's List designation is reserved for students who excel academically and earn at least a 3.3 grade-point average in a semester with a full-time course load.
honors.issuer: Issued by SUNY New Paltz · Feb 2020
